import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int[] arr = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            arr[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        Arrays.sort(arr);
        int T = sc.nextInt();
        int left = 0, right = 0;
        int cnt = 0, ans = 0;
        while (right < n) {
            if (arr[right] - arr[left] <= T) {
                cnt++;
                ans = Math.max(ans, cnt);
                right++;
            } else {
                cnt--;
                left++;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
